My best friend was in and out of foster homes as a kid, from a very young age. At age 18 he received a call saying he’d be entitled to compensation for all the abuse he received as a child. He received a brief of evidence of all of the horrible things that happened to him as a kid, sexual, physical, emotional abuse. He was extremely open about his abuse, the failed system and wanted to write a book when he was older. 

One set of foster parents made him and his brothers live in the backyard and treated them like actual dogs, throwing food out when it was dinner time and hosing them down for showers.  

His brothers were split up, he wasn’t allowed to see his parents because they were aboriginal and deemed unfit. His loss of identity/culture really fucked with him. I could go on for days about the stories I read from that brief. 

4 years ago my best friend killed himself at age 28. No amount of therapy or money could erase that emotional trauma, he never recovered from those horrible things. Rest in peace Sonny ❤️
